betterSidebar.addPluginsBrowseMore: Browse more plugins on GitHub (topic: dsh-better-sidebar)
betterSidebar.addPluginsEmpty: No plugins curated yet — publish yours under the GitHub topic
betterSidebar.addPluginsSearch: Search by plugin name or description…
betterSidebar.addPluginsTabDesc: Sidebar pages (tabs) can be extended by plugins. Plugins register through the ctx.betterSidebar service; clicking Install copies the install command — paste it into a terminal where your DSH profile lives and run it.
betterSidebar.addPluginsViewerDesc: File previewers can be extended by plugins. Plugins register through the ctx.betterSidebar service; clicking Install copies the install command — paste it into a terminal where your DSH profile lives and run it.
betterSidebar.binaryNoPreview: This file type cannot be previewed
betterSidebar.browserBlockedLoopback: Blocked: local and internal addresses cannot be browsed here
betterSidebar.browserBlockedScheme: Blocked: only http/https URLs are allowed
betterSidebar.browserEmbedBlockedDesc: The site forbids being displayed inside other pages (X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors), so it cannot load in the sidebar. Open it directly in your browser instead.
betterSidebar.browserStart: Enter a URL to start browsing (sandbox mode)
betterSidebar.changesClean: No changes in the working tree
betterSidebar.changesLoadError: Session file records are unavailable right now
betterSidebar.changesOpGone: This operation is no longer in the session log
betterSidebar.changesPriorUnknown: Prior content is outside the loaded window; shown as all-added
betterSidebar.changesRedactOff: Redaction off: file content renders verbatim; click to enable
betterSidebar.changesRedactOn: Redaction on: secrets render as [REDACTED]; click to disable (at your own risk)
betterSidebar.changesSessionEmpty: No file operations in this session yet
betterSidebar.cherryPickDesc: Apply the changes of "{subject}" to the current branch.
betterSidebar.closeUnsavedConfirm: This file has unsaved edits. Closing the tab will discard them. Continue?
betterSidebar.commitModelDesc: Pick the model that drafts commit messages; by default it follows the model of the current conversation.
betterSidebar.commitModelEmpty: No models discovered (type provider/model above instead)
betterSidebar.commitModelUnavailable: this deployment exposes no model service; only following is possible
betterSidebar.deleteDescDir: This permanently deletes the directory and everything inside it. This cannot be undone.
betterSidebar.deleteDescFile: This permanently deletes the file. This cannot be undone.
betterSidebar.deleteSelectedDesc: These files and folders will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
betterSidebar.discardDesc: This discards the worktree changes of "{path}" (not recoverable).
betterSidebar.editorEmptyHint: Pick a file from the tree panel or the path input above to start previewing
betterSidebar.editorExplorerMergedDesc: Files switch in place in the same window; new windows start with the tree open
betterSidebar.editorExplorerSplitDesc: Path-less windows are the standalone explorer (tree only); each file opens its own window (tree docked, closed by default)
betterSidebar.editorPathPlaceholder: File path (relative to the session directory or absolute), Enter to open
betterSidebar.editorSearchTruncated: Too many results — showing a partial list
betterSidebar.explorerExcludeDesc: Remove matching entries from the file tree and search entirely (VS Code files.exclude style; * and ? wildcards, a doublestar-slash head matches any depth); excluded entries never block the breadcrumb fold
betterSidebar.filesTruncated: This folder has too many entries; only the first ones are shown
betterSidebar.guideDescBrowser: An embedded browser that can take over chat links
betterSidebar.guideDescFiles: Browse the workspace tree; click a file to preview or edit
betterSidebar.guideDescGit: Git changes and this session's file edits, in one tab
betterSidebar.guideDescSidechat: An independent follow-up thread inheriting this session's context
betterSidebar.guideDescSubagent: Workflow graph, team task board, and background jobs, live
betterSidebar.guideDescTerminal: A real shell (xterm + pty) with reconnect
betterSidebar.htmlNoSandboxWarning: Sandbox off: this HTML runs with full GUI privileges (re-enable in settings)
betterSidebar.jobNotReadYet: Waiting for the model to read this job; its output appears here once the model runs job_output
betterSidebar.mermaidZoomHint: Scroll to zoom · drag to pan · Esc to close
betterSidebar.newFileExists: A file with this name already exists
betterSidebar.noSession: Select a conversation to use the sidebar
betterSidebar.notRepo: This directory is not a git repository
betterSidebar.openWithSettingsCustomDesc: Name + URL template ({path} placeholder) + VSCode-family flag; in remote mode only VSCode-family editors can open a remote path
betterSidebar.openWithSettingsFamilyDesc: This editor speaks the VSCode URL dialect (supports SSH-remote opens)
betterSidebar.openWithSettingsInvalidHint: Editors with a missing name or a template without {path} / scheme:// are not shown in the menu
betterSidebar.openWithSettingsSshDesc: Empty = local workspace; with a user@host or SSH alias, VSCode-family openers switch to the vscode-remote/ssh-remote protocol and the File Manager / Zed / non-VSCode-family custom editors are hidden from the menu
betterSidebar.pluginAgentPersonaDesc: System-prompt personas by workspace or session: one persona can cover several workspace directories and several sessions, matched exactly, by prefix, by substring or by regex, most specific wins, and one persona can be marked as the default; managed from a settings page and a 「人设」tab on the conversation, effective on the next message
betterSidebar.pluginBetterOverleafDesc: Overleaf tab for better-sidebar: direct-CDP browser login (third-party Chromium supported), project list/switch, local git mirrors under <workspace>/overleaf/, two-way git sync with read-only API fallback, and file preview through the sidebar workbench
betterSidebar.pluginBilingualReaderDesc: Read paper PDFs in the DSH sidebar: native PDF rendering, select text to translate it with the LLM, using context while staying fully isolated from the main conversation — a reading aid only
betterSidebar.pluginCodeNavDesc: Code preview navigator: detects the language by file type and highlights syntax, symbol outline (class / method / variable filters + one-click jump), and in-file search (highlight all matches, prev/next, match case) — takes over code file preview in the better-sidebar editor
betterSidebar.pluginDevGitGraphDesc: A vscode-git-graph-faithful commit-graph tab: mounts as a better-sidebar native tab auto-bound to the session workspace, with the full git toolset (checkout/merge/rebase/push/tag/stash), light/dark theme tracking, and click-a-file diff via the built-in DiffTab; requires dsh-better-sidebar installed first
betterSidebar.pluginDocsPanelDesc: Global docs in the DSH sidebar: read your own Markdown notes from any workspace — a file list, an outline, open in Chrome / VS Code, and copy buttons; the docs directory is configurable (default ~/.dsh/docs)
betterSidebar.pluginDshMemoryDeltaDesc: Cross-session memory that injects only what changed — nothing at all when nothing changed — with review-date reminders, relevance-ranked search and a sidebar tab.
betterSidebar.pluginEgoBrowserDesc: The agent browser for DeepSeek Harness: 32 ego_* tools drive a real Chromium, with a native sidebar "ego browser" tab giving a live view of every page the agent visits — you can click, drag, and type to take over. Registers the tab automatically when better-sidebar is present, otherwise falls back to a floating bubble
betterSidebar.pluginFileTraceDesc: Records every file the model reads, writes, or edits; grouped list with content and line diffs, Markdown reading mode and secret redaction; standalone floating window without better-sidebar
betterSidebar.pluginFlowglassDesc: Live session flowgraph with three lanes for user, assistant, and tool calls, plus parallel groups, sub-agent branches, drill-down, and live status; registers a native Flowglass tab when better-sidebar is installed and keeps its standalone drawer as a fallback
betterSidebar.pluginGitForgeDesc: Git Forge tab: GitHub/Gitea (and other forge) account library + per-project grants + hard push policy; tokens stay in local secrets (never in model context); read-only GitForge tool and agent HTTPS credential helper
betterSidebar.pluginGitRemotesDesc: Git Remotes tab: branch/upstream/ahead-behind, fetch (optional prune), ff-only pull, and push only after an in-tab confirm. Does not replace the built-in Git stage/commit tab, and does not offer force-push or a model auto-push tool
betterSidebar.pluginGithubWorkbenchDesc: GitHub Workbench tab: remote repo tree + Issues / Pull requests / Actions with full write support — create Issue/PR, comment, edit, close/reopen, squash·merge·rebase merge (strong confirm), re-run/cancel CI; the repo switcher auto-lists accessible repos and searches public ones; falls back to a standalone right-side panel without better-sidebar
betterSidebar.pluginIdeGitDesc: Git tab for better-sidebar: branch tree (ahead/behind badges, worktree marker), commit graph with text/branch/author/date/path filters, per-file line diff, changes and commit box, plus merge, rebase, cherry-pick, reset, stash and tags; destructive actions confirm first and deletes or discards can be undone. Without better-sidebar it registers into the DSH right sidebar instead, so it works on its own
betterSidebar.pluginMdExportDesc: Adds an "Export" button to the Markdown toolbar in better-sidebar: one click renders the current .md into standalone HTML (tables / code blocks / Mermaid diagrams inlined, layout follows the preview theme) and saves it next to the .md, or exports to PDF via the print dialog
betterSidebar.pluginMnemeDesc: Cross-session memory engine: autoDream background consolidation, session summarization and user profile; SQLite + human-editable Markdown mirrors, fully offline and private. Registers a "Memory Library" tab (memories/entities/status/settings views) when better-sidebar is present and keeps its standalone sidebar panel as a fallback
betterSidebar.pluginOfficeDesc: Office-suite preview (.docx / .xlsx / .pptx) for the better-sidebar editor, keeping the heavy Office render libraries out of the core bundle
betterSidebar.pluginSentinelDesc: Condition-driven agent wakeup: file/process/port/http/command/webhook sensors wake dormant sessions when conditions fire; registers a "Sentinel" tab with the server-wide watch table
betterSidebar.pluginServerDeckDesc: Server card dashboard: one card per host showing online status, OS, uptime and CPU/mem/disk usage with latency; click a card to open an interactive xterm.js terminal; one-click ~/.ssh/config import (git-hosting aliases auto-skipped). Registers a native "Servers" tab when better-sidebar is installed and keeps its standalone drawer as a fallback
betterSidebar.pluginSidebarQaDesc: Select-and-ask: Select conversation text → ask in the right-side panel → a dedicated follow-up session (❓追问) in the same workspace; a fast no-thinking model compresses the main context and injects it with the quote, without interrupting the main conversation. Follow-ups nest, continue, and archive
betterSidebar.pluginSidenoteDesc: Codex-style side chat + selection annotations: fork the current session into a persistent side panel (archived out of the session list, multi-instance, /side command, survives reload, model follows the main session); select assistant text → numbered badge + note editor → an "N annotations" chip that rides your next message, or ask straight into a side chat
betterSidebar.pluginSshTunnelDesc: SSH Tunnel tab: multi-host inventory + per-project grants + local secrets; SSHManager tool (exec/SFTP/session strategies); center interactive terminal and dual-pane SFTP
betterSidebar.pluginSuhuangScrollDesc: Connect the local Suhuang Scroll Runtime to DSH settings and better-sidebar for model configuration, connection tests, and continuous grading controls; requires Suhuang Scroll Runtime and dsh-better-sidebar
betterSidebar.pluginTurnOutlineDesc: Fold the session into user turns (input + tool steps + output) and click any step to jump back to its exact spot in the conversation — no LLM calls, read-only
betterSidebar.pluginTurnReviewDesc: A human gate on the just-finished turn: Approve / Request changes per path with an optional comment; paths grouped by main session / subagent / unattributed; inline snapshot-vs-now diff before you decide. No fork, no /rewind
betterSidebar.pluginTylinaDesc: A Typst document editor sharing the current session workspace, with WYSIWYG typesetting for papers, reports, exams, resumes, charts, posters, sheet music, and slides exported as PPTX
betterSidebar.pluginVideoPreviewDesc: Inline video preview (.mp4/.webm/.mov/.mkv/.avi etc.) for the better-sidebar editor, backed by a dedicated /video host route with HTTP Range (206) support — scrubbing works and files are not capped by the 20MB mediaLimit
betterSidebar.presetDshDesktopDesc: Electron advanced (frameless) mode: macOS reserves a 20px top strip; Windows reserves a 32px title bar when WCO is unavailable
betterSidebar.refreshUnsavedConfirm: The file changed on disk. Refreshing will discard unsaved edits. Continue?
betterSidebar.renameInvalid: The name cannot be empty or contain path separators.
betterSidebar.revertDesc: Create a new commit on the current branch that reverts "{subject}".
betterSidebar.sandboxStatusOn: Sandbox mode: on · pages cannot access the GUI's data or local files; logins and third-party cookies may not work
betterSidebar.saveConflict: The file changed on disk since it was loaded. The save was stopped; your edits are still in the editor.
betterSidebar.settingsBottomTerminalDesc: When the bottom panel is expanded for the first time in a session, try to open a fresh terminal tab there (the terminal quota still applies; on by default)
betterSidebar.settingsBottomTerminalTitle: Auto-open a terminal on the bottom panel's first expansion
betterSidebar.settingsBrowserLoopbackDesc: Comma-separated allowlist of loopback addresses (e.g. localhost:5174 or 127.0.0.1:8080) the sidebar browser may visit; empty blocks all local addresses by default. The sandbox still applies — pages cannot read GUI data
betterSidebar.settingsBrowserSandboxDesc: With the sandbox off, any visited site runs with the same origin as the GUI: it can read session data and act as your logged-in session. Only enable for fully trusted sites
betterSidebar.settingsConflict: The setting changed in another window — please retry
betterSidebar.settingsEditorGitGutterDesc: Tint the line-number gutter of the code editor for uncommitted changes and show that line's blame (author, time and commit summary) on hover; off hides every marker
betterSidebar.settingsFontFamilyDesc: Custom terminal font family (a CSS font-family stack like "JetBrains Mono", monospace; leave empty to follow the theme's monospace font)
betterSidebar.settingsFontSizeDesc: Terminal font size in px (9–32, default 13)
betterSidebar.settingsHtmlDefaultUnsafeDesc: When on, every newly opened HTML preview starts in the unsandboxed state (same origin as the GUI — it can read session files and internal APIs); the status row still offers a one-tap restore
betterSidebar.settingsHtmlDefaultUnsafeTitle: Open HTML previews unsandboxed by default (unsafe)
betterSidebar.settingsHtmlSandboxDesc: With the sandbox off, previewed HTML runs with the same origin as the GUI: it can read session files, local storage and call internal APIs. Only enable for fully trusted files
betterSidebar.settingsIntro: Manage what the side card shows and how it behaves
betterSidebar.settingsJobsDesc: Whenever a new background job appears for the current conversation, create the Tasks page in the side card and mark it with an unread dot (every new job triggers); a side card already expanded on another page is left alone instead of being taken over — click the dot to go there; wide viewports also expand the side card, while narrow full-screen drawers are not forced open; turn off to stop creating it automatically
betterSidebar.settingsJobsTitle: Auto-activate the Tasks page on a new background job
betterSidebar.settingsMobileNoAutoOpenDesc: On a phone / narrow viewport, a new subagent or background job no longer switches to the Tasks page by itself (you can still open it by hand)
betterSidebar.settingsMobileTreeDesc: On a phone / narrow viewport the Tasks page opens as the classic tree instead of the workflow graph; the in-page toggle still switches it ad hoc
betterSidebar.settingsMobileTreeTitle: Default the Tasks page to the tree
betterSidebar.settingsOpenToolsDesc: When enabled, the model can actively open files, folders, and HTTP(S) pages in the sidebar through the sidebar_open tool (off by default)
betterSidebar.settingsOpenToolsTitle: Inject the sidebar-open tool for the model
betterSidebar.settingsOpenWithPluginDesc: By default the plugin’s own targets (file manager / VS Code / Cursor / Zed / custom editors, SSH remotes) show only when the host reports no local associated application; turn this on to keep both side by side
betterSidebar.settingsOpenWithPluginTitle: Always show the plugin’s own Open with targets
betterSidebar.settingsSchemeAutoDesc: Conservative: only the standard Window Controls Overlay API contributes (real caption-overlay height); plain web environments get no modification
betterSidebar.settingsSchemeCustomDesc: Full control: inject custom CSS (can override built-in styles) and set the title-bar shift distance
betterSidebar.settingsSchemeWebDesc: Explicitly declare the official web UI: no adaptation at all (not even standard WCO geometry)
betterSidebar.settingsShellArgsDesc: Explicit shell arguments, space-separated; when non-empty they fully replace the defaults (same contract as the yaml shellArgs)
betterSidebar.settingsShellDesc: Shell spawned for UI and model terminals (absolute path or bare executable). Empty keeps the legacy order: yaml config.shell → $SHELL / login shell / Windows powershell.exe. Applies to terminals opened afterwards
betterSidebar.settingsSubagentDesc: When the current conversation spawns a new subagent, create the Tasks page in the side card and mark it with an unread dot; a side card already expanded on another page is left alone instead of being taken over — click the dot to go there; wide viewports also expand the side card, while narrow full-screen drawers are not forced open; turn off to stop creating it automatically
betterSidebar.settingsSubagentTitle: Auto-activate the Tasks page when a subagent appears
betterSidebar.settingsTitleBarDesc: Pick the title-bar compatibility scheme: auto-detect (default, conservative) / DSH official web / known desktop shells / custom (shift distance + custom CSS)
betterSidebar.settingsTitleBarStripDesc: Title-bar strip height: how far the sidebar buttons and content move down in px (0–120, default 40; applies under the custom scheme)
betterSidebar.settingsToolsDesc: When enabled, the model can create and drive sidebar terminals through the 8 terminal_* tools (off by default)
betterSidebar.settingsToolsTitle: Inject terminal tools for the model
betterSidebar.settingsViewModeDesc: How the Tasks page renders on open (the in-page toggle still flips it ad hoc)
betterSidebar.settingsViewModeGraphDesc: Layered node graph with zoom and pan
betterSidebar.sideChatArchive: Archive this side conversation (find it again via “Show archived” in the session list)
betterSidebar.sideChatArchiveRunning: This thread is running — stop it before archiving
betterSidebar.sideChatCancelTitle: Abort the running turn (queued work is kept)
betterSidebar.sideChatEmptyDesc: Every side conversation is its own tab in the tab strip — it inherits the current session's context and never enters the main conversation
betterSidebar.sideChatFirstPlaceholder: Ask the first question — context inherited…
betterSidebar.sideChatNoTurn: Save is available after the first completed turn
betterSidebar.sideChatPendingDrop: The last unanswered follow-up will not be included in the saved session
betterSidebar.sideChatSaveTitle: Promote this thread to a top-level session in the main session list
betterSidebar.statusTruncated: Too many changes; showing the first 2,000 entries
betterSidebar.subagentEmptyDesc: Subagents spawned under the main agent will appear here
betterSidebar.tabUnread: There is a new page you have not viewed
betterSidebar.teamTaskNoDescription: No description yet — click Edit to add one
betterSidebar.terminalDepsFailed: Terminal dependency node-pty failed to load
betterSidebar.terminalDepsHint: Run the command below in a terminal or cmd on the DSH machine to repair it, then retry (node-pty stays in sync with the DSH core version):
betterSidebar.terminalGone: That terminal no longer exists — start a new one
betterSidebar.terminalShellNotFound: Configured shell not found: {name} — check the shell path under Settings → Side card → Terminal
betterSidebar.terminalUnavailable: The host provides no terminal capability
betterSidebar.truncation: File too large — showing the first 512KB
betterSidebar.uploadDropChat: Drop onto the chat to add images
betterSidebar.uploadTooLarge: File too large (over the upload limit)
